rows.grounds: fused form svam + ācchādya; gerund of covering oneself

items.question: Should the practitioner cover himself with clay and establish a pot there?
premises: covering oneself with clay precedes pot establishment
the goddess is addressed as witness
the pot is established at that place
items.inference: The verse prescribes clay covering followed by pot installation at that place.
uncertainties: svamācchādya may imply covering the body or the self; exact referent is unclear
items.plain_english: Goddess, having covered oneself with clay, one should establish a pot there.
